subtitle: Branches: experimenting without touching the working version

eyebrow: Every branch is a parallel line
caption: Main keeps moving untouched while a branch does its own thing.

code:
git branch rework-ltv-grain
git checkout rework-ltv-grain

# one step:
git checkout -b rework-ltv-grain
git switch -c rework-ltv-grain
caption: All three land in the same place: a new branch, checked out.

code:
$ git switch main
Switched to branch 'main'

$ git branch
  main
* rework-ltv-grain
caption: Your files on disk revert to main — nothing on the other branch is lost.

subtitle: Bringing a branch's work back together with main
